2218164692.FridaGUIHelper: A cross-platform GUI helper for Frida that manages devices, targets, scripts, and frida-server for Android injection workflows.

Frida GUI Helper is a graphical helper for Frida on Windows. It connects ADB devices, attaches to or spawns Android targets, and manages reusable run profiles that save the device, package or target, Attach or Spawn mode, script snapshot, parameters, and frida-server path. It runs pre-injection environment checks, deploys and restarts a matching frida-server with one click, and keeps per-session stdout/stderr logs, exit reasons, exit codes, and durations.
